answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one violet weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 296 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 128 times the capital for one share. The vertex report makes public the merge explicitly at each copper. The per-identity price is 102 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
